description: This is a Java test class for the TagService component in a book management application. It contains unit tests for methods such as findById, findByName, findAll, save, delete, and deleteAll, using Mockito for mocking dependencies and AssertJ for assertions.

classes.name: TagServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for TagService, testing various CRUD operations and exception handling.
